purpose: Resolve Sonchus feeding evidence by tortoise taxon and plant taxon without converting wild observations or related-Testudo records into genus-wide captive feeding prescriptions.

evidence_records.citation: Iftime A, Iftime O. Long term observations on the alimentation of wild Eastern Greek Tortoises Testudo graeca ibera in Dobrogea, Romania. Acta Herpetologica. 2012.
evidence_records.result: Sonchus was among the plant genera whose young leaves were reported as preferentially/frequently consumed in the observed wild diet.
supports: direct wild T. g. ibera consumption of Sonchus at genus resolution
does_not_support: Sonchus oleraceus identification in this population

evidence_records.citation: Bayley JR, Highfield AC. Observations on ecological changes threatening a population of Testudo graeca graeca in the Souss Valley, southern Morocco. Chelonian Conservation and Biology. 1996.
evidence_records.result: Sonchus oleraceus was listed among wild food plants in the diet table for the observed T. g. graeca population.
supports: exact S. oleraceus wild diet record in T. g. graeca
does_not_support: exact T. g. ibera consumption of S. oleraceus

evidence_records.citation: Bielli M, Nardini G, Di Girolamo N, Savarino P. Hematological values for adult eastern Hermann's tortoise (Testudo hermanni boettgeri) in semi-natural conditions. Journal of Veterinary Diagnostic Investigation. 2015.
evidence_records.study_type: veterinary hematology study with husbandry diet description
evidence_records.result: S. oleraceus was included among native wild plants forming the animals' usual semi-natural diet.
supports: documented inclusion of S. oleraceus in a related Testudo semi-natural diet
does_not_support: exact T. g. ibera feeding frequency

canonical_interpretation.strongest_direct_ibera_signal: Iftime & Iftime 2012 directly documents Sonchus consumption by wild T. g. ibera, but only at genus resolution.
canonical_interpretation.species_resolution: S. oleraceus has exact-species records in T. g. graeca and a T. hermanni semi-natural husbandry context; these cannot be relabeled as an exact-species T. g. ibera record.
guardrails: Do not rewrite Sonchus spp. as Sonchus oleraceus solely from related-population evidence.
Do not convert wild preference/frequency language into captive percentages, daily use, staple status, or unlimited feeding.
Do not infer every Sonchus species is equivalent from records for S. oleraceus.
A husbandry diet description is not a controlled toxicology or nutrition trial.
A previously stored Del Vecchio et al. 2011 S. oleraceus record was removed after primary-table audit did not substantiate that species claim.
canonical_interpretation.public_verdict_action: No feeding-level upgrade from this matrix alone. Preserve current canonical assessment unless separate safety/nutrition evidence justifies change.
